recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a portrait-first browser game called Moonlit Life Simulator: Slay Cycle RPG. Preserve a one-thumb life simulator loop where the player starts a run, taps one of four yearly actions, watches money/health/vibe/wisdom/role change, receives occasional random events, can be promoted based on wisdom, and ends the run when health reaches zero or age reaches 100. Present it as a satirical Sailor-Moon-inspired soft-girl life sim with pixel-art aura, rainbowcore sky, crescent-moon guardian avatar, cozy stress-relief tone, meme copy like slay and its giving, and touch-friendly mobile buttons.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Game Reality
- genre: one-thumb browser life simulator / choice RPG
- objective: advance yearly through adult life choices while keeping health/vibe above failure thresholds and improving money, wisdom, and role status
- input model: tap/click Start, then one of four action buttons per turn; restart from terminal overlay
- core loop: choose action, apply baseline yearly stat decay, apply action rewards/costs, sometimes trigger a random life event, age one year, update HUD, check role progression and end conditions
- fail/friction state: health reaching zero ends the run; reaching age 100 completes the century arc; low health or happiness creates warning feedback

## Protected Mechanics
- Four action semantics are preserved: work earns money with extra health/vibe cost; study increases wisdom and costs cash; relax restores vibe/health; social restores vibe and costs cash.
- Yearly progression, stat clamping, random-event chance, career promotion checks, warning feedback, and restart flow are preserved.
- One-thumb mobile button input remains the only control model.

## Remixed Trajectory
Moonlit Life Simulator reframes the same loop as a satirical soft-girl magical adulthood RPG: the player is a Moon Guardian managing Vitality, Vibe, Wisdom, Glitter Cash, and life Arc while resisting burnout youma, subscription goblins, cosmic audits, and adulting stress.
